data.text:
"Create translate_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: translates a single text string between languages.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: translate_text.py
+import os
+import sys
+import requests
+
+
+def translate_text(text: str, source_language: str, target_language: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DEEPL_AUTH_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        "https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate",
+        data={
+            "auth_key": api_key,
+            "text": text,
+            "source_lang": source_language,
+            "target_lang": target_language,
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    translations = data.get("translations", [])
+    if not translations:
+        raise RuntimeError("No translation returned by DeepL")
+    return translations[0]["text"]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: translate_text.py <text> <source_language> <target_language>")
+    print(translate_text(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
